column1: # Fortress room assignment picker, green status above the candidate's name.
# Ghidra decompilation of the 53.17 x64 PE images. Addresses below are RVAs.
# The row reads the assignment mode at +0x10 and iterates the unit's owned
# buildings. For each matching building type it takes the maximum room value,
# with a minimum of 1. No matching building or any other mode skips the draw.
# Each of the four arms initializes a string with 0x20736148 ("Has "), appends
# the grade, then draws it once at the widget's x, y-2.
# mode / building type / grade type / Steam draw / Classic draw:
# The grade helper also has a value <= 0 branch for each type. The four
# no-room literals are unreachable from this row because it requires value > 0.
